# KDP Coloring Book: Adorable Animals

## Master Style Prompt

```
You are an expert coloring-book illustrator. Create clean, child-friendly black-and-white line-art
coloring pages suitable for children aged 3–8. Follow these rules strictly:

STYLE
- Bold, clear black outlines (3–5 pt), pure #000000 on a pure #FFFFFF background.
- No shading, no grey fills, no gradients, no watermarks, no textures.
- Simple enough for young children to color with crayons.
- The illustration fills most of the page with generous white margins on all four sides.
- The whole subject fits inside the page — nothing cropped at the edges.

CONTENT
- Cute, adorable, non-scary animals. No humans. No text or labels.
- The animal is centered, facing slightly toward the viewer, with a simple natural background
  (a flower, a leaf, or a simple ground line is fine).
- No famous characters, no brand logos, no trademarks.

OUTPUT
- Reply only with the illustration. No explanations.

Reply "Ready" if you understand these rules.
```

## Cover

### Front Cover

```
Create a vibrant, colorful children's book cover illustration for "50 Adorable Animals Coloring Book".
Show a joyful group of cartoon animals (puppy, kitten, bunny, panda, elephant) arranged together
in a cheerful scene with bright primary colors. Include the title "50 Adorable Animals Coloring Book"
in large, bold, playful lettering at the top, and "For Kids Ages 3-8" in smaller text at the bottom.
Colorful, energetic, no dark tones. Professional children's book cover quality.
```

### Back Cover

```
Create the back cover for a children's coloring book. Soft pastel background. Include a small
preview collage of 4 black-and-white coloring page thumbnails on the left side. On the right side,
add the following text (style it in a child-friendly font):
Title: "50 Adorable Animals Coloring Book"
Description: "Hours of coloring fun for kids! 50 cute animals to color, one per page."
At the bottom center, leave a white ISBN barcode box (3 in × 2 in).
Keep the overall look clean and professional.
```

### Colored Sample
